comment: Yuvi Decoration team reached our house 2 hours before the party and set up a breathtaking pastel pink ring arch with custom neon sign. All guests were taking photos non-stop! Truly professional service in Patna.

Ordered the romantic rose gold heart arch and fairy lights for my parents' anniversary. The finishing was top notch, balloons didn't deflate even after 2 days. WhatsApp booking and instant receipt made it so easy!
The pastel clouds with the 4ft plush teddy and Oh Baby neon sign looked straight out of Pinterest! Very polite staff and zero advance hassle. Highly recommended for baby showers.
Booked on urgent same-day notice for our showroom inauguration. The 14ft spiral entrance gate in our brand colors was completely ready in under 2 hours. Full GST invoice provided on spot.
